gallery.description: Going past Cardiff Castle in Cardiff. Seen from Duke Street. On this day the Queen attended an event nearby at the Millennium Stadium to unveil a new Welsh Regiment and a parade took place from the castle. So we went to National Museum Cardiff instead. The castle is Grade I listed.
